verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email service, but the evidence never shows Fastmail offering a self-hostable version of its own service. JMAP being an open standard that others can implement, plus a 'Server' listing on jmap.io, describes the protocol ecosystem rather than Fastmail's product, so it earns no credit. The 'Open source and standards' page is only a title with no content about self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
